file:supabase/migrations/01_foundation.s.name: 01_foundation.sql
file:supabase/migrations/01_foundation.s.summary: First migration (must run first). Creates extensions (pgcrypto, uuid-ossp, pg_trgm, citext), core enums (user_role_type, booking_status, booking_source), immutable hospital_id guard trigger, and the foundational helper set_updated_at().

file:supabase/migrations/02_atomic_token.name: 02_atomic_token_engine_&_bookings.sql
file:supabase/migrations/02_atomic_token.summary: Booking engine: bookings, booking_events, queue_sessions, hospital_daily_counters. Atomic token allocation via INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE RETURNING. Enforces patient dedupe by phone.

file:supabase/migrations/07_settlement_e.name: 07_settlement_engine.sql
file:supabase/migrations/07_settlement_e.summary: Settlement engine: daily_collection_entries, hospital_settlements, settlement_items, outstanding_balances. Computes platform vs hospital vs receptionist fees.

file:supabase/migrations/13_payment_engi.name: 13_payment_engine.sql
file:supabase/migrations/13_payment_engi.summary: Payment engine: payment_orders, payment_attempts, payment_refunds, payment_events, financial_ledger. Append-only financial_ledger with trigger-enforced immutability.

file:supabase/migrations/42_whatsapp_con.name: 42_whatsapp_conversational_engine.sql
file:supabase/migrations/42_whatsapp_con.summary: WhatsApp conversational engine: whatsapp_conversation_states table tracking per-phone per-hospital conversation context, state transitions, and handoff flags.

file:supabase/migrations/43_queue_runtim.name: 43_queue_runtime.sql
file:supabase/migrations/43_queue_runtim.summary: Queue runtime: queue_runtime_events audit log for every queue action (call, skip, recall, restore, complete). Provides event sourcing for queue displays and analytics.

file:supabase/migrations/48_privilege_ha.name: 48_privilege_hardening.sql
file:supabase/migrations/48_privilege_ha.summary: Privilege hardening migration: REVOKE PUBLIC EXECUTE on SECURITY DEFINER functions. Documented F16-04: the fail-closed guarantee does not hold - new/resignatured SECURITY DEFINER functions need explicit REVOKE.

file:supabase/functions/_shared/auth.ts.name: auth.ts
file:supabase/functions/_shared/auth.ts.summary: Central authentication and authorization module. resolveAuth verifies JWT, loads profile, queries user_roles for hospital membership and role. requireRole enforces role hierarchy. ROLE_HIERARCHY: global_admin > hospital_admin > doctor > receptionist > patient.

file:supabase/functions/_shared/errors.t.name: errors.ts
file:supabase/functions/_shared/errors.t.summary: 18 SeturError subclasses covering auth, booking, queue, idempotency, rate limit, infrastructure. Each has code, statusCode, retryable flag, optional context. Type guards isSeturError and isRetryable.

file:supabase/functions/_shared/response.name: response.ts
file:supabase/functions/_shared/response.summary: Standardized API response builders: successResponse, createdResponse, errorResponse, handleErrorResponse. JSON envelope: success flag, data, correlationId, timestamp. CORS headers injected on all responses.

file:supabase/functions/_shared/idempote.name: idempotency.ts
file:supabase/functions/_shared/idempote.summary: Idempotency-Key header extraction and withIdempotency wrapper. Claims keys in api_idempotency_keys table, stores response for replay on duplicate POST.

file:supabase/functions/_shared/audit.ts.name: audit.ts
file:supabase/functions/_shared/audit.ts.summary: logAuditEvent helper writes to immutable audit_logs table. Enforces registered action types from audit_action_types, captures actor, hospital, entity, severity, old/new state, correlation id.

file:supabase/functions/_shared/worker.t.name: worker.ts
file:supabase/functions/_shared/worker.t.summary: Background worker primitives: job claim wrappers, lease management, heartbeat, retry, dead-letter handling. Used by run-background-worker edge function.

file:supabase/functions/create-booking/i.name: create-booking/index.ts
file:supabase/functions/create-booking/i.summary: Production-grade booking creation. Full pipeline: CORS, idempotency, auth+role, zod validation, rate limit, hospital open/holiday rules, doctor availability, queue capacity, phone block, find-or-create patient, atomic token allocation, WhatsApp confirmation enqueue, audit log, idempotency completion.

file:supabase/functions/queue-control/in.name: queue-control/index.ts
file:supabase/functions/queue-control/in.summary: Live queue control API. Actions: pause, resume, recall, skip, restore, mark_absent, call, delay, clear_delay, snapshot. All actions are idempotent via deterministic keys.

file:supabase/functions/settlement-engin.name: settlement-engine/index.ts
file:supabase/functions/settlement-engin.summary: Settlement engine edge function: computes hospital_settlements + settlement_items from platform fees, drives payout states, exposes snapshot endpoints for finance dashboards.

file:supabase/functions/create-payment-o.name: create-payment-order/index.ts
file:supabase/functions/create-payment-o.summary: Razorpay integration: creates payment_orders row, calls Razorpay Orders API, returns short_id and amount. Triggers the patient-facing payment flow.

file:supabase/functions/process-whatsapp.name: process-whatsapp-webhook/index.ts
file:supabase/functions/process-whatsapp.summary: Inbound WhatsApp webhook: verifies Meta HMAC signature, deduplicates via webhook_events, hands off to the conversation engine.

file:supabase/functions/send-whatsapp-me.name: send-whatsapp-message/index.ts
file:supabase/functions/send-whatsapp-me.summary: Outbound WhatsApp delivery: invoked by the background worker. Calls Meta Cloud API, writes delivery logs, handles retry/exhaustion via DLQ.

file:supabase/functions/_shared/whatsapp.name: whatsapp_conversation_engine.ts
file:supabase/functions/_shared/whatsapp.summary: Conversation state machine per (hospital_id, phone). Loads/updates whatsapp_conversation_states, routes to intent handler. Delegates actual booking/cancel creation to canonical RPCs - never duplicates business logic.

file:supabase/functions/_shared/whatsapp.name: whatsapp_intent_router.ts
file:supabase/functions/_shared/whatsapp.summary: Deterministic keyword-based intent classifier (no LLM). Maps message text to intents: book, cancel, reschedule, queue, handoff, unknown. Resolves ambiguity to human handoff.

file:supabase/functions/run-background-w.name: run-background-worker/index.ts
file:supabase/functions/run-background-w.summary: Job claiming worker: uses claim_jobs_v2 with SKIP LOCKED, sets lease, processes job payload, writes result or retries with backoff. Heartbeat + DLQ. No scheduler in current environment (P0-02).

file:supabase/functions/run-cron-minute/.name: run-cron-minute/index.ts
file:supabase/functions/run-cron-minute/.summary: Per-minute cron entry point. Enqueues reminders, refresh rollups, run health checks, partition automation. Requires CRON_SECRET.

file:supabase/functions/alert-center/ind.name: alert-center/index.ts
file:supabase/functions/alert-center/ind.summary: Alert center: acknowledge, assign, resolve, escalate, suppress alerts. Phase 1.5 enterprise intelligence addition reading alert_events + alert_activity_log + alert_suppressions.

file:tests/integration/queue_runtime.tes.name: queue_runtime.test.ts
file:tests/integration/queue_runtime.tes.summary: Integration test for queue runtime: validates that queue-control actions produce queue_runtime_events and that one-active-consultation-per-doctor invariant holds.

file:tests/integration/whatsapp_conversa.name: whatsapp_conversational.test.ts
file:tests/integration/whatsapp_conversa.summary: Integration test for WhatsApp conversational flow: inbound message to intent to conversation state to delegated booking creation, verifying tenant isolation and conversation-state transitions.

file:tests/integration/refund_sync.test..name: refund_sync.test.ts
file:tests/integration/refund_sync.test..summary: Integration test for refund synchronization: process-refund must create payment_refunds, write ledger reversal entries, and keep daily_collection_entries consistent.

file:tests/integration/doctor_operations.name: doctor_operations.test.ts
file:tests/integration/doctor_operations.summary: Integration test for doctor operations: validates the 15 doctor workflow actions and the consultation_notes table invariants.

file:tests/integration/privilege_isolati.name: privilege_isolation.test.ts
file:tests/integration/privilege_isolati.summary: Integration test for privilege isolation: verifies that locked SECURITY DEFINER routines return SQLSTATE 42501 (not 401) for anon/authenticated callers. Part of Gate 2 catalog-census-backed boundary proof.
